title: 116. Thinking ethically with Lawrence Sheraton
html_body: This time we're chatting with Lawrence Sheraton about models of economics, will AGI be ethical? moral capabilities of AI, an elusive obvious, how do we know what is right and wrong, “I feel, therefore I know Ethics”, the conditional / contextual nature of ethics, ethical truth, sycophantic and schizophrenic AI, ethical unlearning and more...
